recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a central figure in dark leather attire standing within a row of oversized, bold sans-serif letters against a pure white void. The figure's body physically replaces one of the characters in the word, creating a seamless integration of human form and graphic type.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject as a literal typographic element
Extreme contrast between deep blacks and blown-out whites
Symmetrical weight distribution across the horizontal axis
Interaction between the figure's stance and the surrounding letterforms
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line
Subject wearing dark, textured materials like leather

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, scaled to match the height of the adjacent typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure acts as the primary anchor, bridging the gap between two halves of a word.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Horizontal scan from left to right, interrupted and held by the central figure before completing the word.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space at the top and bottom, creating a 'letterbox' effect for the central content.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure White (#FFFFFF) background providing infinite depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (#000000) for the typography and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle highlights on leather texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with near-zero saturation in the environment.

characterSpecificRedesigns: One character is omitted to be replaced by the human figure's silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, industrial feel of the letterforms.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and weight.
Offers the clean geometric terminals seen in the 'E' and 'L'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person with dreadlocks wearing a black leather trench coat and leather pants, standing in a wide power-pose against a seamless pure white background. The lighting should be high-contrast, emphasizing the texture of the leather.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, ultra-bold black sans-serif uppercase letters on either side of the subject so the subject's body occupies the space of a missing letter in the word.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with no shadows?
Does the subject's height match the letter height?
Is the typography heavy enough to balance the visual weight of the person?

adjustableVariables: Vertical placement of the text line
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Unique jewelry or identifiable branding on clothing

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject and type

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the missing letter.
Check that the subject's feet are level with the baseline of the letters.
Verify the leather texture has specular highlights.
Confirm no color bleed from the subject into the white void.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place [Subject in Dark Textured Clothing] as a central pillar within [Ultra-Bold Sans-Serif Word] against [Infinite White Background] to create a [Graphic-Human Hybrid] composition.
